description: Fagradalsfjall 2021 MrLavaLoba infrastructure hazard and barrier assessment provides documented use of MrLavaLoba simulations for critical-infrastructure exposure and eruption response. The provider is Pedersen, Gro B. M.; Pfeffer, Melissa A.; Barsotti, Sara; Tarquini, Simone; de'Michieli Vitturi, Mattia; Óladóttir, Bergrún A.; Þrastarson, Ragnar Heiðar. Geographical and temporal coverage: The study records pre-eruption and during-eruption modelling at Fagradalsfjall, Iceland, in 2021. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is an operational hazard-modelling account during a real event. Individual simulation forecasts were not checked against observations here. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
